content.text:
Yep, new 2am wakings are really common around 18 to 24 months. Separation worries, teething, and nap or bedtime shifts are usual triggers.

For tonight, keep the wake-up boring. Go in, keep the lights off and your voice low, and give a short "night night, I'm here" with a pat. Skip the feed, the play and the screen, and leave before they're fully asleep. That keeps 2am from turning into a reward.
